label: Automotive Technician
summary: Two Automobile Resumes against Aviation and Designing.
job_description:
Our service centre is hiring an Automotive Technician to diagnose and repair customer vehicles across engine, brake and electrical work.

What we need:
- 6-8 years automotive experience
- Strong diagnostic skills
- vehicle repair
- pre‑delivery inspection
- equipment maintenance

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Associate degree; ASE Master Certified (all 8); Subaru Master Technician; diagnostics; ASE certification; Subaru expertise; mentorship; technical reporting.
